comparison: Strictly beats rhbi-v12 (8/18 PASS) and matches empf-v8 (10/18 PASS) on untouched long-horizon 14k endurance with sub-0.035 cov_trace_bias on both grid100_14k and staggered100_14k, while trailing unified-v11 (15/18 PASS).
conclusion: 10/18 PASS on untouched r3-tier3-long-horizon-holdout-v1 (RTX A6000, seed 0, axiom-v3 37f537db8; 6 FAIL, 2 blocked by failed parent dependencies five_word_joint_hold and rotated100_14k): PASS on two_pole, unused_token_hold, ae_gan_hold, clockfree_audit, zero_tanh_smoke, mode_hold, grid100, staggered100 (score=0.4392), grid100_14k (prec=0.9873, tv=0.0149, bias=0.0340, score=0.3145), and staggered100_14k (prec=0.9864, tv=0.0183, bias=0.0237, score=0.2748).
